Take-home Message

Lipoma

圓／橢圓、邊界清楚、均質脂肪衰減、沒有高衰減成分。

Infiltrative lipoma

脂肪衰減為主，但形狀不規則、邊界混合、線狀條紋進入肌肉間隙。

Liposarcoma

不均質、軟組織成分高、結節／團塊狀 component、可有礦物化與淋巴結病變。

關鍵限制

CT 可 stratify risk，但最終診斷仍需 histopathology。

CT 判讀流程

  1. 先確認脂肪成分：病灶是否以 fat attenuation 為主？HU 是否接近脂肪？
  2. 判斷形狀：round/oval 支持 lipoma；irregular 支持 infiltrative lipoma。
  3. 看邊界：well-defined vs mixed/poorly defined，尤其是否沿肌肉或筋膜浸潤。
  4. 看內部成分：linear striation 偏 infiltrative；nodular/globular/mass soft tissue component 偏 liposarcoma。
  5. 找 aggressive signs：mineralization、osteolysis、regional lymphadenopathy、suspected metastatic lesions。
  6. 給臨床建議：採樣 soft tissue component，而不是只採樣脂肪區；異常淋巴結需 staging。

快速鑑別卡

看到乾淨脂肪腫塊

well-defined、oval、homogeneous、無 soft tissue nodule → lipoma favored。

看到脂肪沿肌肉走

irregular、linear striations、muscle plane infiltration → infiltrative lipoma favored。

看到軟組織結節

heterogeneous fat-containing mass + nodular soft tissue → liposarcoma concern。

看到淋巴結或骨侵犯

regional lymphadenopathy、osteolysis、mineralization → staging / biopsy needed。

影像圖例｜Figures

Fig. 1 — Simple lipoma：well-demarcated fat-attenuating mass

中文：11 歲未結紮雌性 Labrador Retriever，診斷為 lipoma。第六腰椎水平可見大型橢圓形、均質脂肪衰減腫塊，壓迫鄰近腹壁並將該水平腹腔臟器向軸側推移；未見鄰近腹壁浸潤。影像窗寬 400、窗位 40。

English: An 11-year-old intact female Labrador Retriever with a lipoma. At L6, the lesion is a large oval, homogeneous, fat-attenuating mass that compresses the abdominal wall and displaces abdominal organs axially, without detectable wall infiltration. WW 400, WL 40.

Fig. 2 — Necrotic lipoma：fat mass with hyperattenuating striations

中文：11 歲已去勢混種公犬，診斷為 necrotic lipoma。第四頸椎水平可見以脂肪衰減為主但不均質的腫塊，內含較高衰減條紋；病理顯示為腫塊內壞死、發炎脂肪。腫塊將氣管、左頸動脈與交感神經幹向右推移，並壓迫左頸靜脈。影像窗寬 400、窗位 40。

English: An 11-year-old neutered male mixed-breed dog with a necrotic lipoma at C4. The mass is predominantly fat attenuating but heterogeneous, with internal hyperattenuating striations corresponding to necrotic inflamed fat. It shifts the trachea, left carotid artery, and sympathetic trunk rightward and compresses the left jugular vein. WW 400, WL 40.

Fig. 3 — Infiltrative lipoma：linear striations and muscular infiltration

中文：5 歲已去勢 Springer Spaniel 公犬，診斷為 infiltrative lipoma。左腋窩與前胸壁水平可見橢圓形、未顯影、均質脂肪衰減腫塊，邊界同時具有清楚與不清楚區域，內含細而 wispy 的線狀條紋。腫塊向內側延伸並浸潤胸入口與前胸壁肌群，接觸左第一與第二肋骨但未見骨溶解；線狀高衰減條紋代表胸肌與腹側鋸肌的殘留肌肉成分。影像窗寬 700、窗位 150。

English: A 5-year-old neutered male Springer Spaniel with an infiltrative lipoma of the left axillary and cranial thoracic wall region. The mass is mostly homogeneous fat attenuation, nonenhancing, and contains fine linear wispy striations. It extends through thoracic inlet and cranial thoracic wall musculature and contacts the first and second ribs without osteolysis. The striations represent residual pectoral and serratus ventralis muscle. WW 700, WL 150.

Fig. 4 — Liposarcoma：heterogeneous soft tissue component and osteolysis

中文：11 歲未結紮 Rottweiler 公犬，診斷為 liposarcoma。可見橢圓形不均質腫塊，部分邊界清楚、部分邊界不清，並造成左髂骨翼與第七腰椎左橫突骨溶解。腫塊中央具有結節狀軟組織成分。影像窗寬 700、窗位 150。

English: An 11-year-old intact male Rottweiler with a liposarcoma. The oval heterogeneous mass has both well- and poorly demarcated borders, causes lysis of the left iliac wing and left L7 transverse process, and contains a central nodular soft tissue component. WW 700, WL 150.

Fig. 5 — Intra-abdominal liposarcoma and metastatic concern

中文：8 歲未結紮 German Shepherd 雌犬，診斷為腹腔內 liposarcoma。胃部水平橫切顯影 CT 可見腹腔內多灶至融合、以不均質脂肪衰減為主的腫塊，內含不規則結節狀軟組織成分，並有大量重力依賴性腹水。同一病例另一張橫切影像顯示胸骨淋巴結明顯腫大、圓形分葉狀邊界並呈不均質顯影。影像窗寬 400、窗位 40。

English: An 8-year-old intact female German Shepherd with intra-abdominal liposarcoma. The abdominal mass is multifocal to coalescing and predominantly heterogeneous fat attenuation, with irregular nodular soft tissue components and abundant dependent abdominal fluid. A second image from the same patient shows a markedly enlarged sternal lymph node with rounded lobulated margins and heterogeneous enhancement. WW 400, WL 40.

Clinical Application

Sampling strategy

若 CT 顯示脂肪腫塊內有 nodular soft tissue component，採樣應優先對準軟組織結節區，而非單純脂肪區，否則可能低估 liposarcoma。

Surgical planning

Infiltrative lipoma 的核心問題是範圍與浸潤，而不是單純良性／惡性。報告應清楚描述浸潤肌群、筋膜平面、骨接觸或骨侵犯，協助外科切除範圍規劃。

Recommended impression phrase

Fat-containing mass with imaging features most suggestive of [lipoma / infiltrative lipoma / liposarcoma]. Histopathology remains necessary for definitive diagnosis.
